issue_context.title: No PropertiesChanged signal emitted when freezing/thawing unit
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

249

### Used distribution

Ubuntu 22.04.3

### Linux kernel version used

6.5.0-14-generic

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

systemd

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

`PropertiesChanged` signal with the updated `FreezerState` property is emitted on
**service**: org.freedesktop.systemd1
**path**: /org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/<masked-unit-name> (e.g. cow_2eservice)
**interface**: org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

No `PropertiesChanged` signal is emitted on `org.freedesktop.systemd1 /org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/<masked-unit-name> org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties`

### Steps to reproduce the problem

Using the gist here: https://gist.github.com/engelmi/a1ed5af612dbecb51a27b28b83d1a33e

1. Copy the `cow.service` from gist (could be any other service, the unit name is just hardcoded in `watch.py`)
2. Copy and run python script `watch.py` from gist to watch for property changed signals on D-Bus
3. In other terminal run
   1. `systemctl start cow.service` (signals are received)
   2. `systemctl freeze cow.service` (no signal is received)
   3. `systemctl thaw cow.service` (also no signal received)
   4. `systemctl stop cow.service` (signals are received again, with Freezerstate)


### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

_No response_
comments:
`PropertiesChanged` signal is emitted if calls `bus_unit_send_change_signal` function when the unit's `freezer_state` is changed.
Edit: It seems better to call `unit_add_to_dbus_queue`.

review_comments: (I'd prefer not to use special glyphs in basic state change messages. None of the existing unit state change logs use this, and I think these should be readable even in the most limited environments)
shouldn't this change be in the "core/unit: rename freezer "target" to "objective"" commit rather than the "core/cgroup: skip freezer action wholly if current == objective" commit?
